name: stl-mesh-editor
description: Browser app to open STL files, delete parts of the mesh and close the resulting holes.

scripts.desktop: vite build && cd desktop && npm install && npm start
scripts.desktop:win: vite build && cd desktop && npm install && npm run dist:win
scripts.desktop:mac: vite build && cd desktop && npm install && npm run dist:mac
scripts.desktop:linux: vite build && cd desktop && npm install && npm run dist:linux
